title: Your place's story here
blurb: Sample story: this is how a shared story looks. Own a café, a homestay or a little shop? Share its story and it gets a pin here and a plaque at the real spot.
text:
Every place in Goa has a story: the family that has baked poee in the same oven for three generations, the balcão where the whole street gathers for Christmas, the shack that started with one table on the sand.

Send us yours, with a few photos, and we will build it into virtual Goa: a pin on the map, a plaque at the real spot, and one day a little quest that brings players to your door.
